catalogs.title: Ophelia — Polymer farm
catalogs.notes: Stay if Botany Lab spawned. That room is the polymer-farm tile.

rooms.looks: Indoor Grineer lab with plant vats, glass tanks, and polymer crates. If you see the greenhouse/lab, stay.

catalogs.title: Zabala — Nanospores farm
catalogs.notes: Stay if the Infested Reactor tile spawned.

rooms.looks: Infested ship reactor chamber — glowing core, heavy infestation on the walls.

catalogs.title: Assur / Galleon Survival
catalogs.notes: Assur farmers often look for Connector Four. Mark it if you see it.

rooms.notes: Compact connector used as a camp / loot room.
rooms.looks: Short galleon connector with a tight camp spot. Look for Connector Four's compact T-shape.

catalogs.title: Io / Gas City Survival
catalogs.notes: No must-have farm room yet. Grade uses compactness and any rooms you add.

catalogs.title: Persto — Albrecht Survival
catalogs.notes: Same lab tiles as Armatus. No single must-have farm room — mark the room you spawned and reject ones you abort.

rooms.looks: Massive brain held above a Vessel head. Two stories; a ceiling vent left of the brain leads to a hidden chamber.
Two-floor cathedral library. Grimoire Altar at the back centre — matching Requiem glyphs on the walls open the floor.
Huge pendulum wreathed in electricity. Crystals in alcoves at each swing extreme; a Pom-2 opens the far yellow door.
Electric towers by the loading door. Yellow locked door on the right; Necramech spawn on the left.
A Vessel reaching its hand to a ceiling opening. Hack the far-right Pom-2, then break the Operator crystal on the balcony.
Tree on a central platform. Breakable gates under the stairs, near the Necramech spawn.
Three sand-filled orbs and one empty. Shoot the ceiling crystal to fill the empty orb and drop the platform.
Circular room with two locked yellow doors. Ceiling vent where a dome support beam meets the ceiling.
Intersection with stairs and a large ornate grate. Shoot the unlit orb on the bridge, or use a nearby wall vent.

catalogs.title: Terrorem — Orokin Derelict Survival
catalogs.notes: No single must-have farm room. Camp a compact combat tile; abort the tentacle room. Mark what spawned and reject rooms you leave.

rooms.looks: Infested Orokin hangar bay. Large but readable — a common Terrorem camp if the sightlines stay short.
Open derelict plaza with broken gold and infestation. Same tile as the Orokin Derelict Plaza Captura scene.
Overgrown courtyard with derelict trees and planters. Enemies funnel through the doorways.
Frozen Orokin halls with cryo floor mist. Jump the ice tiles; death orbs often sit in the next room.
Hallway or chamber with spinning laser death orbs. Compact camp if you pin the orbs and hold a doorway.
Narrow Orokin bridge over a pit or infested drop. Tight choke, longer sightlines.
Timed parkour treasure course with lasers and vents. Side loot, not a farm camp.
Small gold-rimmed vault door (dragon key). Replaces a side door — not a combat tile.
Giant open room with infested branches you traverse. Survival only uses it as a dead end — long spawns, usually abort.
